subject: Trading
title: Bill Ackman: The Activist Showman
description: A quick, practical guide to Bill Ackman: The Activist Showman.

hook.text: Bill Ackman bet $1 billion that Herbalife was a fraud. He lost. Then he made $2.6 billion on a COVID trade in weeks.

buildup.text: Ackman runs Pershing Square, taking concentrated positions in companies he believes are mispriced.

discovery.text: His Herbalife short became a public war with Carl Icahn, who took the opposite side. Both traded on television.

twist.text: In March 2020, Ackman bought $27 million in credit hedges and made $2.6 billion in 30 days as markets crashed.

climax.text: Ackman's career shows extreme highs and lows. Concentrated bets create spectacular wins and spectacular failures.

punchline.text: Go big or go home. He's done both, repeatedly.

quiz.question: What was the outcome of Ackman's famous Herbalife short?
options: He lost the bet while Carl Icahn profited taking the opposite side
